fields.System.Title: INV-901 — Maintain the availability table
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an integration client, I want availability answered from a single indexed read, so
that the webshop can ask about hundreds of products without straining the database.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given any movement, status change, or reservation change, then
  • product_availability is updated in the same transaction.
  • - Given the projection, then it excludes quarantine, damaged stock, blocked locations,
  • expired batches, and virtual locations — matching
  • [INV-103](INV-103-query-available-quantity.md) exactly.
  • - Given a projection row, then it carries last_updated_at and every response exposes
  • it.
  • - Given allocation, then it does not read this table.
  • - Given the update, then it does not measurably slow confirm endpoints.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory |
| Tables | product_availability, stock_balance |
| Risks | Projection used for allocation ([doc 09 §12](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); sync update slowing hot paths ([doc 08 §10](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · performance |
